units.source_text: 那天晚上，我十点以后才离开先生家。

en.t: That evening, I did not leave Sensei's house until after ten o'clock.

units.source_text: 因为两三天内我要回故乡，所以在离席之前，我说了些告别的话。

en.t: Since I was to return to my hometown within two or three days, before I took my leave I said a few words of farewell.

units.source_text: “我暂时不能来看先生了。”

en.t: “I will not be able to come see you for a while, Sensei.”

units.source_text: “九月能回来吧。”

en.t: “You will be back in September, won't you?”

units.source_text: 我已经毕业了，所以也无须九月回来，但也没有想过要在炎热的八月回东京。

en.t: I had already graduated, so there was no need for me to come back in September, but I had no thought of returning to Tokyo in the heat of August either.

units.source_text: 我并不需要把宝贵的时间花在寻找工作上。

en.t: I did not need to spend precious time looking for work.

units.source_text: “大概要到九月左右吧。”

en.t: “It will probably be around September.”

units.source_text: “那么，祝你一路平安。

en.t: “Well then, have a safe trip.

units.source_text: 这个夏天我们也许要到什么地方去走走，东京天气太热了。

en.t: This summer we may go somewhere for a while; Tokyo is far too hot.

units.source_text: 要是去的话，到了地方会给你寄一张明信片的。”

en.t: If we do go, I will send you a postcard when we get there.”

units.source_text: “出去的话，准备去哪儿？”

en.t: “If you go away, where are you thinking of going?”

units.source_text: 听了我的问话，先生呵呵笑着。

en.t: Hearing my question, Sensei laughed quietly.

units.source_text: “还没有决定去不去呢。”

en.t: “We have not even decided whether we are going yet.”

units.source_text: 我正要起身的时候，先生突然拉住我，问：“对了，你父亲的病怎么样了？”

en.t: Just as I was about to get up, Sensei suddenly stopped me and asked, “By the way, how is your father's illness?”

units.source_text: 说到父亲的病情，我一无所知。

en.t: As for my father's condition, I knew nothing at all.

units.source_text: 只是觉得既然来信没说什么，大概就是没事吧。

en.t: I only thought that since the letters had said nothing, he was probably all right.

units.source_text: “这种病可不能掉以轻心哪，要是发展到尿毒症，可就没法治了。”

en.t: “You must not take that kind of illness lightly; if it develops into uremia, there will be no treating it.”

units.source_text: 我不知道“尿毒症”是什么意思，上次寒假在家乡见到医生时，我没有听医生说过这样的术语。

en.t: I did not know what “uremia” meant, and when I had seen the doctor in my hometown during the last winter break, I had not heard him use any such term.

units.source_text: “真的要当心哪！”夫人也说，

en.t: “You really must be careful!” his wife also said,

units.source_text: “你知道吗，病毒要是进了脑子，人就完啦。

en.t: “You know, if the poison reaches the brain, it is all over.

units.source_text: 这可不是闹着玩的。”

en.t: This is no laughing matter.”
